Every slice C1=q-3*C0*h with q!=0 and h in ker(D_+) is polynomially left-right equivalent to the tangent slice and hence foundational; the opposite shear and every finite composition are symmetric. A variable-time single shear is an automorphism exactly when its time is invariant, and every polynomial upper or lower Borel gauge reduces to this case. For a lower-upper pair U(p)L(q), the exact Jacobian is (1+X_q(p))(1+D_-(q))-D_-(p)X_q(q), where X_q=D_+-qH-q^2D_-. A saturated projective Tschirnhausen flag with scalar mixed coefficient reduces all residual ambiguity to Borel and puts the family in C1=q; the full simple-root cover is then the cartesian pullback of the foundational map along G=(C0,C2,C3).
